c74object.name: evi_am
c74object.digest: evieve Gen Object. Basic AM processor with saturation and choice of LFO shapes
c74object.description:
evi_am is an abstraction for using inside gen~ or GenExpr.
evi_am.gendsp requires the GenExpr file(s):
evi_counting.genexpr, evi_smooth_bank.genexpr, evi_adaa.genexpr, evi_lfo.genexpr
evi_am is also available in MSP as: evi.am~.
A basic but useful AM processor with the core basic algorithm and assocoiated cotrols surrounded by saturation when driving the modulation signal > 0 dB. The saturation is anti-aliased and can cope with very hot input and has the feel of a guitar pedal. Because everybody needs a bosom for a pillow.

geninlet.name: left
geninlet.digest: or Mono Audio In. Left or mono audio input depending on the @stereo attribute.

geninlet.name: right
geninlet.digest: Audio In. Right audio input if @stereo attribute is on.

geninlet.name: reset
geninlet.digest: Naive. Reset of internal LFO phases is naive and not anti-aliased.

attribute.name: depth
attribute.description: Internally, increasing depth increases the amplitude size of the LFO movement.

attribute.name: factor
attribute.description: Multiply @rate (speed in Hz) by this factor.

attribute.name: gain
attribute.description: Below 0 dB, @gain attenuates the gain affecting the LFO modulation. Above 0 dB the gain increases the LFO gain and also saturates the audio output. evi.am~ can take high aggressive gain staging and will saturate increasingly strongly in an anti-aliased way.

attribute.name: lfomode
attribute.description: If on, changes to the speed (@rate) of the internal LFOs are synchronised to zero reset of phase, which can produce seemless updating of speed changes. Otherwise the speed (@rate) updates smoothly morphing changes.

attribute.name: lfoout
attribute.description: Switch the LFO outputs (outlets 3 and 4) to output raw -1..1 range or output the actual amplitude (AM) used.

attribute.name: lfowave
attribute.description: The shape of the LFOs driving the modulation. 0=bypass, 1=up, 2=down, 3=tri, 4=sine (default), 5=tanh, 6=square, 7=rand step, 8=rand linear, 9=rand cubic, 10=noise. Switching LFO wave is synchronised to zero crossing phase. LFOs are always slightly smoothed, even hard edges such as square and random.

attribute.name: lfowidth
attribute.description: The pulse width of the LFO wave shapes that use it: 3=triangle, 5=tanh, 6=square.

attribute.name: rate
attribute.description: The frequency in Hz of the LFO phases.

attribute.name: smooth
attribute.description: The smoothing time of the internal parameters.

attribute.name: spread
attribute.description: The left/right spread of the audio outputs, actually the phase offset of the two internal LFOs. 0..1 is mapped to 0..180 degrees shift.

attribute.name: stereo
attribute.description: If off, the audio input to the process is taken only from the Left inlet 1 as mono. If @stereo is on, the audio inputs are taken from both left (1) and right (2) inlets. The audio output is always stereo.
